negative_prompt: watermark, text signature, logo in corner, artist name, copyright notice, blurry, low resolution, bad anatomy, CGI, 3D render, smooth plastic skin, digital illustration, anime, cartoon drawing, sharp vector art, shiny plastic toy, extra fingers, malformed hands, smiling mouth, open mouth, cheerful expression, fluorescent modern lighting, flat white background
reconstruction_priority: tactile stop-motion craft materials — AI often homogenizes clay, wool fibers, and knitwear into generic glossy CGI plastic
facial anatomy with thick black rectangular glasses and elongated nose — AI often misaligns the spectacle frames or draws incorrect eye gaze
hand interaction with vintage paper fragments inside the wooden box — AI frequently generates fused fingers or chaotic paper mush
macro shallow depth of field and authentic fiber fuzz — AI tends to over-sharpen background noise and remove natural stop-motion texture
